summary:
Fresher with hands-on experience in statutory audit, financial statement preparation, and compliance review for multi-sector
clients. Skilled in IFC walkthroughs, GST audit, and leveraging SAP and MS-Excel for process improvement and risk mitigation.

jobs.company: Singhi & Co, Chartered Accountants(Network firm of Moore Global Network Limited
sub_sections: Noida
Handled a 4-member team in the statutory audit of Maharaja Shree Umaid Mills Ltd. (Textile, ~₹500 Cr turnover), covering audit
program design, assertion testing, compliance review, and preparation of the audit report
Led process reviews across H2R & P2P (Sutlej Textiles & Industries Limited, Baddi Plant) and O2C (Mangalam Cement Limited),
driving efficiency and control improvements
Prepared Financial Statements for Mobility Division of JBM Auto group (consolidated turnover of ~₹400 Cr) in compliace with
Schedule III and IND AS
Executed ledger scrutiny for JBM Auto (Mobility Division), identifying discrepancies including double invoice bookings,
duplicate vendor codes, and incorrect inter-company transaction routing; verified debtors/creditors, matched expenses with
POs, detected duplicate payments while performing Bank reconcilation, Quarterly provisioning sheets reconciling expense
provisions with actual invoices and identifying pending bookings and prepared Fixed Asset Register (FAR)
Conducted limited review and performed variance analysis for Jindal Poly Group (Plastics & Packaging) and Rupa & Company
Ltd. (Textile & Apparel), identifying key deviations and insights.
Prepared UFCE certificates for Statutory audit clients in compliance with RBI Act requirements.
Conducted process walkthroughs during IFC for statutory audit clients to gain in-depth understanding of business operations
and controls.
Independently handled tax audits and compliance reviews for corporate clients across Textile, Industrial Engineering, Health
care and FMCG sectors.
Prepared and reviewed Deferred Tax calculations and tax reconciliations for Form 26AS, TDS, and TCS, detecting
inconsistencies and ensuring accurate recording of transactions and full statutory compliance
Executed end-to-end compliance audit for Dharam Pal Prem Chand Ltd. (FMCG), detecting GST rate and HSN code mismatches
